decisions.reason: We keep it because it still fits our construction and industrial transport direction and weak traction can be attributed to temporary pandemic-period disruption, though the lower visible commitment than the lift lines makes it the most vulnerable.

We keep it because the multi-model furniture-lift line represents a clear public commitment and a good fit with our lifting, safety and service capabilities, which encourages continued support despite any disappointing early results.

We keep it because the multi-model building-material-lift line is central to our announced path in specialized lifting equipment and the sunk engineering and service investment argues for persistence.

We keep it because it complements the inclined-lift family and shares service and application know-how, although its narrower niche makes withdrawal somewhat more likely than for the core line products.
